If we split like that we can get legal redlines locked and then quickly hand off implementation items to the onboarding team.

- Wed Sep 29, 2:00–2:45 PM ET

1) 0–30m: top 6 redline items (clauses: data residency, retention, SLA credits, indemnity carve-outs, subprocessor list, encryption)
2) 30–45m: onboarding checkpoint — SSO type, evidence bundle owner, target go-live window
